newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - New York City.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - New York City.

text.p: General Obligation Bonds, Taxable Bonds of Fiscal 1997 Series E and F, To Be Dated the Date of Delivery on or About
The following information, released by Alan G. Hevesi, the Comptroller of the City, summarizes the Notice of Sale dated October 25, 1996, issued by the City.
Sealed bids will be received for all of the Bonds on

at 11:00 a.m. by the Comptroller at his office in Room 517, 5th floor, Municipal Building, One Centre Street, New York, NY 10007. Notice of a change in such place, time or date or in other matters relating to the Bonds may be given by a supplemental notice or notices. The City will specify revised annual maturities and other matters in a

supplemental notice not later than 1:00 p.m. on the day prior to the time scheduled for the receipt of bids. Bidders may obtain the Notice of Sale, which is included in the Preliminary Official Statement dated October 25, 1996, and the Revised Bid Form when available, by faxing the Customer Service Department, Global Financial Press, at (212) 387-7217.
